# Curated real Search episode

semantic_search_real_v8.json retains the unchanged Search episode at producer
index 27 of the actual offline v8 export of the frozen third-phase Windows log.
RawFollower and RawReducer authenticate the source request and continuity. V8
uses the existing consumed-response gate with the fixed SearchResp type only
for the new opt-in version; the default response map is unchanged.

The private source references are request record623/GRE index5, response
record632, and first continuous successor record634/GRE index0. The original
5,625,878-byte source SHA-256 is
4e888a7d29a9ac7f25c5d7aabc9517d5042c260d4065fa6c136e64ae45b616af.
Raw bytes, authentication/account values, hidden card faces, prompt identifiers
and screenshots remain local and ignored. Portable replay does not reauthenticate
that removed private evidence.

Full producer counts are 54 matched pairs, 29 exported, 25 unsupported and no
omissions. This curated container counts only its retained episode: 1 matched,
1 exported, no unsupported or omitted pairs. source.framed_records remains the
actual full source count, 732. Episode values exactly equal the producer's output;
only the surrounding sample list, counts and unsupported list describe curation.

The request provides four itemsSought references. They use a separate
request-scoped search_item namespace and carry request_identifier_only visibility.
They have no hidden card identities and cannot be joined numerically to public
object_ref values, even when alias integers coincide. The 41-item itemsToSearch
list is validated privately for uniqueness and subset membership, then omitted;
only its count survives. The source is an already public own Stack instance
with unknown card catalog identity.

The client submits offered position0. The first continuous successor contains
an explicit ObjectIdChanged edge from the selected request item to a newly public
object and a matching source-attributed Library-to-Battlefield Put annotation.
The four other AbilityInstanceCreated annotations are omitted. Later states,
resolution, triggered choices and parent Activate causality are outside this
episode. No old hidden card face is compared or filled from the new public card.
Minimum count, fail-to-find semantics, complete legality, server acceptance and
rule effect remain unknown. Empty selections are unsupported evidence, without
claiming that they violate or satisfy an unknown minimum.

The additional raw-envelope and malformed-artifact cases in
test_semantic_search.py are explicitly synthetic controls.
